prose: A new year of InnerVerse kicks off with a paradigm busting pow-wow about the power of our higher mind to transform our material body in astounding ways. In 2016, RJ Spina became permanently paralyzed (according to his surgeons and doctors), waking up in the hospital with no feeling or movement from the chest down. Tune in to find out how RJ intuitively, miraculously, and fully healed from this incurable condition, the eternal metaphysical truths that his experience reveals, how to get into the driver's seat of the miracle machine, and much more.
ext: RJ walks us through a demonstration of the Ascend the Frequencies healing technique that he used to reignite dead nerves in his spine. We also discuss Ascended Masters and the Bible Deconstructed, and bridging astrotheology with one's personal philosophy.
music: InnerVerse intro theme by Conspiracy Music Guru
